name: Cosim
desc:
When applied to a ExternalSystemVerilogModule, will configure it so that
it can be cosimulated in a SystemVerilog simulator along with the ROHD
simulator.

name: acceptsEmptyPortConnections
desc:
Indicates whether this module accepts empty port connections when being
instantiated in SystemVerilog.

name: addInOut
desc:
Registers a signal as an inOut to this Module and returns an inOut
port that can be consumed inside this Module.

name: addInOutArray
desc:
Registers and returns an inOut LogicArray port to this Module with
the specified dimensions, elementWidth, and numUnpackedDimensions
named name.

name: addInput
desc:
Registers a signal as an input to this Module and returns an input
port that can be consumed.

name: addInputArray
desc:
Registers and returns an input LogicArray port to this Module with
the specified dimensions, elementWidth, and numUnpackedDimensions
named name.

name: addInterfacePorts
desc:
Connects the source to this Module using Interface.connectIO and
returns a copy of the source that can be used within this module.

name: addOutput
desc:
Registers an output to this Module and returns an output port that
can be driven by this Module or consumed outside of it.

name: addOutputArray
desc:
Registers and returns an output LogicArray port to this Module with
the specified dimensions, elementWidth, and numUnpackedDimensions
named name.

name: addPairInterfacePorts
desc:
Connects the source to this Module using PairInterface.pairConnectIO
and returns a copy of the source that can be used within this module.

name: addTypedInOut
desc:
Registers a signal as an inOut to this Module and returns an inOut
port that can be consumed inside this Module. The type of the port will
be LogicType and constructed via Logic.clone, so it is required that
the source implements clone functionality that matches the type and
properly updates the Logic.name as well.

name: addTypedInput
desc:
Registers a signal as an input to this Module and returns an input
port that can be consumed. The type of the port will be LogicType and
constructed via Logic.clone, so it is required that the source
implements clone functionality that matches the type and properly updates
the Logic.name as well.

name: addTypedOutput
desc:
Registers an output to this Module and returns an output port that
can be driven by this Module or consumed outside of it. The type of the
port will be LogicType and constructed via logicGenerator, which must
properly update the name of the generated LogicType as well.

name: build
desc: Builds the Module and all subModules within it.

name: compileArgs
desc:
A list of additional arguments to pass to compile phase of the
SystemVerilog simulator.

name: connectCosimulation
desc: Starts the SystemVerilog simulation and connects it to the ROHD simulator.

name: cosimHierarchy
desc:
The hierarchy from the SystemVerilog cosimulation top to reach this
module.

name: cosimRegister
desc:
Registers the current Cosim module with the cosimulator
for generation and cosimulation.  Only registered modules
will be cosimulated.

name: defaultPythonModuleName
desc: The default name of the python module containing the connector.

name: definitionName
desc:
The definition name of this Module used when instantiating instances in
generated code.

name: definitionParameters
desc:
A collection of SystemVerilog SystemVerilogParameterDefinitions to be
declared on the definition when generating SystemVerilog for this Module
if generatedDefinitionType is DefinitionGenerationType.standard.

name: definitionVerilog
desc: A custom SystemVerilog definition to be produced for this Module.

name: endCosim
desc:
Passes an "END" message to Cosim as if it had been sent by the other
simulator.  This is helpful in cases where the simulator dies unexpectedly
without gracefully notifying Cosim.

name: expressionlessInputs
desc:
A list of names of inputs which should not have any SystemVerilog
expressions (including constants) in-lined into them. Only signal names
will be fed into these.

name: extraArgs
desc:
A list of additional arguments to pass to both compile and execute phase
of the SystemVerilog simulation.

name: filelists
desc: A list of filelists (.f files) to pass to the compile stage.

name: generateConnector
desc: Generates collateral for building and executing a cosimulation.

name: generateSynth
desc: Returns a synthesized version of this Module.

name: generatedDefinitionType
desc:
What kind of SystemVerilog definition this Module generates, or whether
it does at all.

name: hasBuilt
desc: Indicates whether this Module has had the build method called on it.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: hierarchicalName
desc:
Returns the hierarchical name of this Module with the parent hierarchy
included, separated by .s, e.g. top.mid.leaf.  Because it depends on
hierarchy, this is only valid after build has been called.

name: hierarchy
desc:
Returns an Iterable of Modules representing the hierarchical path to
this Module.

name: hierarchyString
desc:
Returns a pretty-print String of the heirarchy of all Modules within
this Module.

name: inOut
desc:
Accesses the Logic associated with this Modules inOut port
named name.

name: inOutSource
desc:
The original source provided to the creation of the inOut port name
via addInOut or addInOutArray.

name: inOuts
desc:
A map from inOut port names to this Module to corresponding Logic
signals.

name: input
desc:
Accesses the Logic associated with this Modules input port
named name.

name: inputSource
desc:
The original source provided to the creation of the input port name
via addInput or addInputArray.

name: inputs
desc:
A map from input port names to this Module to corresponding Logic
signals.

name: instantiationVerilog
desc:
Generates custom SystemVerilog to be injected in place of a module
instantiation.

name: internalSignals
desc:
An Iterable of all Logics contained within this Module which are
not an input or output port of this Module.

name: isInOut
desc:
Returns true iff signal is the same Logic as the inOut port of this
Module with the same name.

name: isInput
desc:
Returns true iff signal is the same Logic as the input port of this
Module with the same name.

name: isOutput
desc:
Returns true iff signal is the same Logic as the output port of this
Module with the same name.

name: isPort
desc:
Returns true iff signal is the same Logic as an input, output, or
inOut port of this Module with the same name.

name: logger
desc: An enablable logger (null if disabled) for Cosim related information.

name: name
desc: The name of this Module.

name: noSuchMethod
desc: Invoked when a nonexistent method or property is accessed.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: output
desc:
Accesses the Logic associated with this Modules output port
named name.

name: outputs
desc:
A map from output port names to this Module to corresponding Logic
signals.

name: parameters
desc:
A map of parameter names and values to be passed to the SystemVerilog
module.

name: parent
desc: The parent Module of this Module.

name: registreeName
desc: The unique instance name for this registree in cosimulation.

name: registrees
desc: A collection of all registered Cosim modules.

name: reserveDefinitionName
desc:
If true, guarantees definitionName is maintained by a Synthesizer,
or else it will fail.

name: reserveName
desc:
If true, guarantees uniqueInstanceName matches name or else the
build will fail.

name: reset
desc: Resets all context for cosimulation.

name: runtimeType
desc: A representation of the runtime type of the object.

name: signals
desc:
An Iterable of all Logics contained within this Module, including
inputs, outputs, and internal signals of this Module.

name: subModules
desc: An Iterable of all Modules contained within this Module.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: tryInOut
desc: Provides the inOut named name if it exists, otherwise null.

name: tryInput
desc: Provides the input named name if it exists, otherwise null.

name: tryOutput
desc: Provides the output named name if it exists, otherwise null.

name: uniqueInstanceName
desc:
If this module has a parent, after build this will be a guaranteed
unique name within its scope.

name: verilogSources
desc: A list of verilog source files to include in the build.

name: CosimConfig
desc: Configuration information for cosimulation.

name: CosimConfig.new
desc: Constructs information for cosimulation.

name: connect
desc: Initializes the connection to cosimulation.

name: enableLogging
desc: If true, additional debug logging will be enabled for cosimulation.

name: throwOnUnexpectedEnd
desc:
If true, throws an UnexpectedEndOfSimulation exception in case the
cosimulation ends unexpectedly.  Otherwise, just prints a warning.

name: CosimConnection
desc: Represents a connection to a cosimulation.

name: CosimConnection.new
desc: A connection to cosimulation via socket.

name: disconnect
desc: A flow to run as part of disconnection from cosimulation.

name: extractSocketPort
desc:
Extracts a socket number from a stdout message from the cosimulation
process.  Returns null if no socket number is found in message.

name: socket
desc: A socket to communicate with the cosimulation.

name: CosimCustomConfig
desc:
A cosimulation configuration which is intended for use when you already
have a custom build and/or simulation setup created and wish to cosimulate
using that rather than an auto-generated one.

name: CosimCustomConfig.new
desc: A custom configuration for running cosimulation.

name: startCosimProcess
desc:
Starts the execution of the SystemVerilog simulator with all
proper arguments to accept communication from ROHD.

name: CosimPortConfig
desc: Configuration to connect to cosimulation on a specified port.

name: CosimPortConfig.new
desc: Creates a configuration to connect to cosimulation on port port.

name: connect
desc: Initializes the connection to cosimulation.

name: port
desc: The port to connect to for cosimulation.

name: CosimProcessConfig
desc:
Abstract class for configurations that can be passed to start a
cosimulation.

name: CosimProcessConfig.new
desc: Creates a configuration which launches a sub-process to cosimulate with.

name: connect
desc: Initializes the connection to cosimulation.

name: directory
desc: Directory where files will be dumped into.

name: startCosimProcess
desc:
Starts the execution of the SystemVerilog simulator with all
proper arguments to accept communication from ROHD.

name: CosimWrapConfig
desc:
A cosimulation configuration for supplying the minimum information to
get a cosimulation running.

name: CosimWrapConfig.new
desc: Generates a SystemVerilog wrapper and a Makefile to be called by default.

name: dumpWaves
desc:
When set to true, will configure the SystemVerilog simulator to dump waves
during simulation.

name: environment
desc:
A set of environment variables to be made visible to the process running
the SystemVerilog simulator.

name: startCosimProcess
desc:
Starts the execution of the SystemVerilog simulator with all
proper arguments to accept communication from ROHD.

name: systemVerilogSimulator
desc: The simulator to use for cosimulation.

name: SystemVerilogSimulator
desc: A selection of a type of SystemVerilog Simulator.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.
